title.from: Confirm hook blocks a staged synthetic bad commit and allows clean commits (existing hook, default config)
title.to: Verify staged sensitive blocking and clean commits for LeftBlock/Pudicus

description.from: Reverified 2026-10-20 using the exact existing installed hook in a disposable repository: clean fixture commits with receipt; a generated synthetic sensitive fixture is rejected, leaves HEAD unchanged, and does not expose its value. Both partial-staging directions are covered. Current staged changes also passed inspection through temporary index/object storage, preserving the real index/history. Acceptance evidence is complete locally; new product source remains unpublished. Existing closed status is retained.
description.to: Local acceptance remains complete: the exact existing Pudicus hook in a disposable repository accepted clean content with a receipt and rejected a generated sensitive fixture without changing HEAD or exposing its value. Both partial-staging directions are covered. The original staged changes were checked through temporary index/object storage. Preserve this evidence for LeftBlock compatibility; canonical package and per-project runtime tests are tracked separately and must not be inferred from this completed test.
